subject.title: [Feature]: Mac app titlebar buttons should follow sidebar state (search + new session when collapsed)

question: Should the macOS dashboard adopt adaptive titlebar controls—history at the visible sidebar edge, and search/new-session when navigation is hidden?
rationale: The implementation path is clear, but this changes persistent native navigation design and establishes a cross-version contract in an M4 stable companion-app surface.

options.title: Adopt adaptive titlebar
options.body: Implement the typed state bridge and canonical action events with the existing fixed controls as the older-bundle fallback.

options.title: Keep fixed navigation
options.body: Retain toggle/back/forward in the titlebar and improve hidden-navigation access only through Control UI chrome or shortcuts.

recommendation.title: Adopt adaptive titlebar
recommendation.body: Implement the typed state bridge and canonical action events with the existing fixed controls as the older-bundle fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history for both the native titlebar bridge and surrounding sidebar design makes steipete the strongest available decision owner.
